extraMeanings.en: the way in which sound or images are reproduced
extraMeanings.exampleEn: This speaker system offers excellent sound reproduction.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bu hoparlör sistemi mükemmel ses kalitesi sunuyor.

extraMeanings.en: kept for a particular person or purpose
extraMeanings.exampleEn: This table is reserved for a party of six.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bu masa altı kişilik bir grup için ayrılmıştır.

extraMeanings.tr: direnç (elektrik veya vücudun hastalığa karşı direnci)
extraMeanings.en: the ability to not be affected by something, or opposition in an electrical circuit
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Regular exercise builds up the body's resistance to disease.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Düzenli egzersiz vücudun hastalığa karşı direncini artırır.

extraMeanings.en: the level of detail in an image or screen
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The new monitor has a much higher resolution than the old one.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yeni monitörün çözünürlüğü eskisinden çok daha yüksek.

extraMeanings.en: firm determination to do something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She faced the challenge with great resolution.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Zorlukla büyük bir kararlılıkla yüzleşti.

extraMeanings.en: a short account of one's education and work experience
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Please send us your resume and a cover letter.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Lütfen bize özgeçmişinizi ve bir ön yazı gönderin.

extraMeanings.en: the opposite of something, or the back side
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The instructions are printed on the reverse of the page.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Talimatlar sayfanın arka yüzüne basılmıştır.

extraMeanings.en: the gear that makes a vehicle move backwards
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He put the car into reverse and backed out of the driveway.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Arabayı geri vitese takıp garaj yolundan geri çıktı.

extraMeanings.en: one complete turn around a central point
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The engine runs at three thousand revolutions per minute.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Motor dakikada üç bin devir yapıyor.

extraMeanings.en: to have something as the main subject or focus
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Her whole life revolves around her children.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bütün hayatı çocuklarının etrafında dönüyor.

extraMeanings.en: something that is hard to understand or explain
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The cause of the disease remains a riddle to scientists.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hastalığın nedeni bilim insanları için bir muamma olmaya devam ediyor.

extraMeanings.en: an additional clause or condition added to a document
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The senator attached a rider to the bill.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Senatör yasa tasarısına bir ek madde iliştirdi.

extraMeanings.en: an established custom or traditional practice
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Getting a driver's license is a rite of passage for many teenagers.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ehliyet almak birçok genç için bir geçiş töreni niteliğindedir.

extraMeanings.en: something done regularly and in the same way
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A cup of coffee in the morning is part of my daily ritual.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sabahları bir fincan kahve günlük rutinimin bir parçası.

extraMeanings.en: to be as good as someone or something else
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Few cities can rival Paris for its beauty.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çok az şehir güzellik açısından Paris'le boy ölçüşebilir.

extraMeanings.en: to laugh very loudly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The audience roared with laughter at his jokes.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Seyirci şakalarına kahkahalarla güldü.

extraMeanings.en: a green salad leaf with a peppery taste
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The salad had rocket, tomatoes and parmesan.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Salatada roka, domates ve parmesan vardı.

extraMeanings.en: difficult and likely to fail; unstable
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Their marriage went through a rocky period.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Evlilikleri çalkantılı bir dönemden geçti.

extraMeanings.en: a payment made to an author or artist for use of their work
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The author earns royalties on every book sold.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yazar satılan her kitaptan telif ücreti kazanıyor.

extraMeanings.en: a thick blanket used for warmth
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She wrapped a rug around her legs to keep warm.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sıcak kalmak için bacaklarına bir battaniye sardı.

extraMeanings.en: a large bag made of strong material
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He carried a sack of potatoes on his shoulder.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Omzunda bir çuval patates taşıyordu.

extraMeanings.en: wise, especially as a result of experience
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She gave me some sage advice about my career.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bana kariyerim hakkında akıllıca bir öğüt verdi.

extraMeanings.en: a sheet of fabric that catches the wind to move a boat
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They raised the sail as the wind picked up.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Rüzgar sertleşince yelkeni açtılar.

extraMeanings.en: a gathering of intellectuals or artists at someone's home
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She hosted a literary salon every Friday evening.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Her cuma akşamı edebi bir sohbet toplantısı düzenlerdi.

extraMeanings.en: to increase the size of a business or operation
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The startup plans to scale up its workforce next year.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Girişim gelecek yıl iş gücünü artırmayı planlıyor.

extraMeanings.en: a lasting emotional or psychological effect from a bad experience
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The war left deep scars on the whole generation.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Savaş bütün nesilde derin ruhsal yaralar bıraktı.

extraMeanings.en: the smell trail left by an animal or person
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The dogs picked up the fox's scent.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Köpekler tilkinin iz kokusunu aldı.

extraMeanings.en: a secret and dishonest plan
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They devised a scheme to defraud the elderly.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yaşlıları dolandırmak için bir dolap çevirdiler.

extraMeanings.en: to get rid of or cancel a plan or system
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The government decided to scrap the new tax.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hükümet yeni vergiyi iptal etmeye karar verdi.

extraMeanings.en: to close tightly, or to make something final
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She sealed the envelope and posted it.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Zarfı kapatıp postaladı.

extraMeanings.en: used to give an example or approximate figure
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Let's meet again in, say, two weeks.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Diyelim ki iki hafta sonra tekrar buluşalım.

extraMeanings.en: a torn place in cloth or paper
extraMeanings.exampleEn: There was a large rip in his jeans.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kotunda büyük bir yırtık vardı.

extraMeanings.en: to move back or withdraw from a position or decision
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The army was forced to retreat from the city.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ordu şehirden geri çekilmek zorunda kaldı.

extraMeanings.en: to regard or treat with deep respect
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The elders are reverenced in this community.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bu toplulukta yaşlılara derin saygı gösterilir.
